title: Target Challenge
description: A player is randomly selected to be the target every 5 minutes.
body:
A player is randomly selected to be the target every 5 minutes. 

This datapack was coded by my friends ZappierVirus526 and Vakore, idea by me.

**HOW TO USE**

There are a number of teams, if the player's goal is to kill the target, but you don't want them to be a target at any point, you will use the following command:
/team join Hunter *ign*

If you want a player to be in the list of possible players that can become a Target, you will use the following command:
/team join Bodyguard *ign*

To start the game, you will use the following command:
/function zappier:operations/starttargetrandomizer
